sentences.text: Incisoscutum was a member of the class Placodermi, an extinct group of armored fish.
This genus belongs to the family Camuropiscidae.
The genus contains two species named after Alex Ritchie and Sarah Long.
Its jaw shape suggests it ate hard-shelled prey.
Fossils indicate that live birth and internal fertilization were common among early jawed vertebrates outside the crown group Gnathostomata.
Finding many individuals together suggests they may have swarmed in schools.
These animals lived during the Frasnian stage, from 382.31 to 372.15 million years ago.
They inhabited the warm, stable reef waters of the Devonian Gogo Formation.
